name: Liquid rise
visual_intent: Liquid-inspired scene change: a wavy surface rises to fill the frame; it drains away or becomes the next background.
implementation_summary: Morphs a wave region through rising levels, cuts scenes when full, then drains or hides (mode 'become').
runtime_api: Studio.fx.liquid(tl, outScene, inScene, at, {color, mode, duration, seed})

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test tests/test-studio-runtime.py and frame review of projects/masala-chai-recipe (landscape, portrait, square) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-10-30. Not yet rendered through HyperFrames on the Apple M2 host, so not approved.
